n31e3882d98.headline: South Africa's gas master plan ready, official says
n31e3882d98.summary: South Africa's master plan to develop its gas market is ready after repeated delays. It will go to cabinet before public release, a senior mineral resources and energy department official said.
n31e3882d98.why: A national gas plan shapes energy supply options and investment in power generation, which matters for industrial costs and energy security in Africa's most developed economy.

n69f179da7b.headline: Treasury concedes pressure on debt
n69f179da7b.summary: Malawi's Ministry of Finance acknowledged significant challenges in public debt management, leading to increased borrowing and an unsustainable debt burden. It cited Covid-19, the Ukraine war and tightening conditions.
n69f179da7b.why: Heavy public debt and rising borrowing costs affect a country's ability to finance spending and its access to international credit.

naae37d4200.headline: Global economic growth continues to slow at 3% in 2023 - IMF
naae37d4200.summary: The IMF forecasts global growth will slow from 3.5% in 2022 to 3.0% in 2023 and 2.9% in 2024.
naae37d4200.why: The International Monetary Fund publishes global growth forecasts that shape expectations for trade, capital flows and central bank policy.

n8ff2d9bf6b.headline: IMF: Kazakhstan’s Economy Displays Resilience, Surpassing 2023 Growth Projections
n8ff2d9bf6b.summary: The IMF said Kazakhstan's economy is displaying resilience and surpassing its 2023 growth projections.
n8ff2d9bf6b.why: The IMF's assessments of growth shape how investors and lenders view Kazakhstan's economic outlook and its oil-dependent economy.

n199e3b66a4.headline: PCL, Cane Products resolve PressCane shareholders wrangle
n199e3b66a4.summary: Press Corporation plc and Cane Products Limited said they had amicably resolved a long-running shareholding dispute in PressCane Limited, based in Chikwawa, Malawi.
n199e3b66a4.why: Press Corporation is a Malawian conglomerate, and settling shareholder disputes can clear the way for governance and operational decisions at subsidiaries.

n953fd1eab3.headline: San Leon Energy receives up to USD187 million investment from Tri Ri
n953fd1eab3.summary: San Leon Energy said it received up to USD187 million of investment from Tri Ri. The funding will let it become majority shareholder in Energy Link Infrastructure Malta Ltd.
n953fd1eab3.why: San Leon Energy is an energy company with interests in Malta-based infrastructure, and majority control of an asset can change its strategy and capital structure.

n52121958d8.headline: Italian companies see bleaker economic outlook-central bank survey
n52121958d8.summary: Italian companies' views on the economic outlook darkened markedly in the third quarter, the Bank of Italy said in its quarterly survey, citing uncertainty.
n52121958d8.why: The Bank of Italy is the country's central bank, and its business surveys offer an early read on corporate investment and hiring plans.

n10f32f2846.headline: Chinese developer Country Garden says it cannot meet debt payment deadline
n10f32f2846.summary: Chinese developer Country Garden says it cannot meet a debt payment deadline. The firm's admission is the latest sign of distress in China's property industry.
n10f32f2846.why: Country Garden is one of China's largest property developers, and its debt stress is closely watched as a gauge of the health of China's real estate sector and its lenders.
n10f32f2846.why_moved: The developer's admission that it cannot meet a debt payment deadline heightens default concerns across China's property sector.

n4b487c716a.headline: IMF lowers Sub-Saharan Africa growth forecasts
n4b487c716a.summary: The IMF said Sub-Saharan Africa's economy will shrink in 2023 for a second year before rebounding in 2024. Growth is expected to fall to 3.3% this year from 4% last year.
n4b487c716a.why: The IMF is the global lender that publishes the regional economic outlooks used by governments, lenders and investors across Africa.

nfc011c5362.headline: IMF Says World Economy Resilient To Shocks But 'Limping'
nfc011c5362.summary: The IMF left its 2023 global growth forecast unchanged but warned the economy is limping as inflation remains high. It downgraded outlooks for China and Germany.
nfc011c5362.why: The International Monetary Fund is the Washington-based lender that publishes global growth forecasts used by governments, central banks and investors. Its outlook shapes expectations for trade, rates and emerging-market risk.

n239f16fea5.headline: Orbán in trouble? IMF cuts Hungarian GDP forecast
n239f16fea5.summary: The International Monetary Fund forecasts Hungary's economy will contract by 0.3 percent this year, raising questions about the country's budget.
n239f16fea5.why: The IMF's forecasts inform investor views on sovereign risk, and Hungary's growth and budget path affect its bonds and forint.

n74b6bc996a.summary: Portuguese Prime Minister António Costa announced the termination of tax benefits for non-habitual residents starting in 2024.
